title: From Idea to Live Stream in 3 Steps
subtitle: No commissions. No waiting. Just describe, generate, and stream.

step1.title: Describe your character
step1.description: Type a short description or upload a reference image. The AI generates 4 unique options to choose from.

step2.title: Get expressions automatically
step2.description: One click generates a full expression pack — happy, angry, sad, surprised — all in your character's style.

step3.title: Go live on stream
step3.description: Paste a single Browser Source link into OBS. Your avatar lip-syncs to your mic in real time.
